title: Counter-argumentation
intent: formative · Intellectual Depth (Thinking) · click through the process
statement: Strengthen your own position by seeking out and answering the best case against it — not the weakest.

steps.title: State your thesis
steps.text: Write the claim you are defending clearly enough to attack.

steps.title: Build the strongest opposing case
steps.text: Steel-man it: make the objection as convincing as its best advocate would.

steps.title: Find its best evidence
steps.text: Give the counter-case real support, not a straw version you can knock down.

steps.title: Answer it honestly
steps.text: Concede what is right in it, then show why your thesis still holds — or adjust it.

steps.title: Strengthen or revise
steps.text: A thesis that survives its best objection is stronger; one that does not should change.

feedForward.text: Write the single best objection to your argument, then a two-sentence reply that concedes something real.
